{{Quote|A distress call has been received from an Habassan convoy near Pii II.|Admiral Gial Ackbar|audio=PiiIIDistress-XWingTourOfDuty.flac|<ref name="Tour" />}}
'''Pii II''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]]. A [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] ball of [[Stone/Legends|rock]], the planet was the second to [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] the [[Pii sun]]. Pii II, along with the rest of the Pii [[Star system/Legends|system]], was located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Sometime between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], a [[Battle near Pii II|battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] occurred near Pii II.

==Description==
Pii II<ref name="Tour" /> was a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]], [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] ball of [[Stone/Legends|rock]] that was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] the [[Pii sun]]. The planet was located in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]<ref name="Greel" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The planet, like the rest of the Pii system, was a seven-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] journey away from the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]<ref name="Greel" /> and along the [[Old Corellian Run]] and the [[Trans Gulf Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="Atlas" />

The Pii system, and therefore Pii II, was originally located on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. When that hyperspace route changed its course<ref name="Atlas" /> at some point between around [[11,000 BBY]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]<ref name="OldCorellianRunDate" /> and as a result no longer ran through the Pii system, the planet remained on the Old Corellian Run.<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
{{Quote|They are under attack by Imperial forces and are requesting help.|Admiral Gial Ackbar, briefing Red Squadron|audio=RequestingHelp-XWingTourOfDuty.flac|<ref name="Tour" />}}
At some point between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that, with respect to approximately one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]&mdash;which the book places in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&mdash;[[Operation Ram's Head]] took place "over the next year." Thus, the operation occurred between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. As ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]'' takes place after Operation Ram's Head and before the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], a process that ''The New Essential Chronology'' places between 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the events of the [[Star Wars video games|game]], including the [[battle near Pii II]], must take place between 1 ABY at the earliest and 3 ABY at the latest.</ref> the [[Habassa]]n [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] [[Jess (freighter group)|''Jess'']] was attacked by [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], forcing the convoy to send a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Tour" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]<ref name="After">''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] displayed Pii II on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|holoscreen]] while briefing the Alliance's [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] on the distress signal aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] and dispatched the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to answer the call. Red Squadron, comprised of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]], arrived and [[Battle near Pii II|intercepted]] the Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starships]] near Pii II.<ref name="Tour" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pii II first appeared via a holoscreen display in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]'',<ref name="Tour" /> the second expansion pack for<ref name="Expansion">{{StoryCite|story=Rebel Alliance Incurs Even More Imperial Wrath in Second X-Wing® Tour of Duty Expansion Disk|book=The Adventurer 6|nolink=1}}</ref>  the [[LucasArts]]<ref name="Release">{{LucasArts|url=20th/history_2.htm|text=Part Two: The Classics, 1990 - 1994}}</ref> [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']].<ref name="Expansion" /> ''Star Wars: X-Wing'' was released in [[February]] [[1993]]<ref name="Release" /> with the second expansion following that summer.<ref name="Expansion" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Pii system, and therefore Pii II, in grid square R-16.<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[2013]] [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] stated [[Greel wood/Legends|greel wood]] came from Pii II and [[Pii IV]],<ref name="Edge">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> while multiple sources establish the [[Wood/Legends|wood]] came from [[Pii III]] and Pii IV,<ref name="SWAJGreel">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref><ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="CSWEGreel">{{CSWECite|I|366|greel wood}}</ref> the third and fourth planets of the Pii system, respectively.<ref name="SWAJGreel" /> This article assumes the rulebook's mention to be an error.
